text:
Situation: VinCRIStine sulfate supply is limited. Corvale East holds 64 vials (1 mg/mL, 2 mL SDV) providing 20.4 days on hand. Corvale General holds 67.51 vials providing 23.4 days on hand at current usage rates.

Why (FDA record): The product on our labels is manufactured by Hospira Australia Pty Ltd (FEI 3001174929). FDA inspected that plant on 2014-03-04 and classified the inspection OAI. A Warning Letter was issued to the same facility on 2014-09-26. The most recent inspection ended 2022-09-02 and was classified VAI. As of 2026-10-21, the drug is not listed on the FDA drug shortage database.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs or emergency imports. Continued monitoring is required.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place maximum allowable orders with wholesalers and explore secondary distributors; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to contact Hospira/Pfizer for allocation status and estimated resupply dates; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to report daily inventory levels to Pharmacy Director until both sites exceed 30 days on hand; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Pharmacy Director to notify P&T Committee if projected days on hand fall below 14 at either site; requires P&T Committee Chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Initiating therapeutic alternatives or protocol changes at this time.
